svg.title: Illustration of MoEraser architecture and noise injection-restore tuning
svg.desc: Frame inventory: f01 contains panel (a) two dashed Erase/Preserve side modules, text embedding projector, MoEraser, colored arrows and the large MoE architecture block with router, experts, scale/layernorm/MLP, alpha/beta/gamma routing and a gated linear unit. f06 contains panel (b) NIR tuning: text embedding projector plus structured noise creates corrupted projector, then restore process with corrupted projector, MoEraser, MoEraser*, embeddings, opposing red transition arrows, spiderweb corruption marks, flame erasing icon, snowflake preserving icon, and bottom feature/noise labels. Symmetry basis: panel (a) is left-to-right flow from dual inputs into a central rounded architecture; panel (b) is left-to-right corruption and restoration separated by a vertical dashed divider.
